name: Quest Giver
description: Someone standing somewhere who gives the player a reason to go: they hand out the level's jobs one at a time, ask after the one you are on, take it back when it is done and see you paid. It owns the person: who they are, which jobs are theirs to give, where the conversation opens at each stage of each job, and the mark over their head, `!` with work to give and `?` with work waiting to be handed back. It owns none of the work: the jobs, their counting and their payout belong to progression.quest_log, which this offers into and hands back to. It owns none of the words on screen: the box it depends on holds the lines and draws them, and an answer that takes a job or hands one back says so with `act`, which the box passes through and this acts on. Where the person stands belongs to the runtime, which also decides who is close enough to speak to.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: givers
inputs.description: Who gives work here: [{id, name, greeting, quests}]. `greeting` names the node in ui.dialogue_box's tree a conversation opens at when this giver has nothing on offer, nothing waiting and nothing out. Each entry in `quests` is a progression.quest_log quest plus `talk: {offer, active, ready}`, the nodes a conversation opens at while that quest is on offer, taken, or done and waiting. Quests are offered in the order written; `after` holds one back until the quest it names is complete. An answer whose `act` is {accept: id} takes one of this giver's quests, {turnIn: id} hands one back, {next: giverId} asks what else there is; an act that does not go through re-opens the conversation where things now stand.

outputs.name: givers
outputs.description: Every giver as {id, name, marker}: '!' with work to give, '?' with work waiting to be handed back, null otherwise.

outputs.name: markerOf
outputs.description: markerOf(id): that mark for one giver.

outputs.name: talkTo
outputs.description: talkTo(id): opens the conversation where that giver's work stands: the first quest waiting to be handed back, else the first on offer, else the first taken, else the greeting. False for an unknown giver or a box with no tree.

provenance: Requested from play, 2026-09-23: someone standing in the clearing above the dungeon crawler who gives you a reason to go down: talk to them, take the job, do it, come back and get paid. Searched first: nothing in the catalogue hands work out or takes it back.
